summary: Results-focused Information Technology management professional offering twenty‑two years of progressive leadership experience. Transforms high‑potential staff into outstanding leaders who demonstrate creativity and savvy critical to financial and operational success. Proven ability to cut costs, reduce staff turnover, and cultivate a culture of ownership and pride.

experience.title: Senior Information Technology Manager
responsibilities: Program manager for migrating 13,000 Exchange on‑premise mail users to Office 365.
Implemented and managed systems for asset/lease reporting, enterprise backup, patch management, and application distribution for 10,000+ PCs worldwide.
Reduced global data center footprint from 23 to 2 North American sites and one regional hub.
Led deployment and management of Microsoft products (Server, Desktop, Office 365, Active Directory, Skype, Federated Services), SQL, and System Center.
Oversaw disaster recovery across multiple data centers and storage arrays.
Managed a team of IT professionals, controlled expenses, and defined strategic business plans.

experience.title: Senior Information Systems Professional
responsibilities: Developed long‑ and short‑term technology server and storage plans.
Formulated policies and procedures and delivered technology presentations to internal stakeholders.
Collaborated with Washington State agencies on healthcare data sharing and trusted networks.
Supervised technicians in network and infrastructure deployment and support.
Designed and executed directory‑based services, monitored server/storage systems, and implemented fault tolerance.

experience.title: Network Support Engineer
responsibilities: Provided support for NT, Netware, Macintosh, Cisco, 3Com, and Bay networks.
Installed, upgraded, repaired, configured, and troubleshot multi‑platform infrastructures.
Implemented firewall and other network security functions.

experience.title: Senior Technician
responsibilities: Troubleshot, identified, and resolved end‑user hardware and application issues.
Trained and provided technical direction to junior technicians.

projects.name: Exchange to Office 365 Migration
projects.description: Led the migration of 13,000 on‑premise Exchange mail users to Office 365, ensuring minimal downtime and data integrity.
